fields.value: Dataset underlying the article: Different neural mechanisms underlie nonhabitual honesty and nonhabitual cheating

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Welcome to the data repository for our paper entitled 'different neural mechanisms underlie nonhabitual honesty and nonhabitual cheating'

In this study, we further explored findings from a previous study on the neural mechanisms underlying individual differences in dishonesty (https://https://www.pnas.org/content/117/32/19080). Here we explore whether neural patterns when overriding the default to be honest differ from the neural patterns overriding the default to cheat.

Here, you can find the neural data, behavioral data, analysis scripts and stimuli used in this project.

For a detailed description of the content of this repository, please refer to the README file.
